question: If the square of maximum area is to be taken out from a circular steel plate of radius 28 cm, then find the area of remaining part of the circular steel plate. (cm²)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**If the square of the maximum area is to be taken out from a circular steel plate of radius r cm, 

The area of remaining part of the circular steel plate = (8)/(7)r²

According to the question,

The radius of the circle = 28 cm

Therefore, 

The area of the remaining part of the circular steel plate = (8)/(7) × 28²&am
